extracted.name: No-Knead, No-Yeast 20-Minute Pizza — Faster Than Delivery!
extracted.description: Craving pizza but short on time? This lazy pizza recipe skips the kneading and yeast — just mix, pour, top, and bake. Ready in just 20 minutes, it’s perfect for busy days or lazy evenings. Customize it with your favorite toppings and enjoy a hot, cheesy homemade pizza faster than delivery!
instruction_lines: In a bowl, mix eggs, sour cream, kefir (or mayo), salt, and baking powder.
Add flour and mix until smooth.
Pour the batter in a circle onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Add your favorite toppings on top.
Bake at 200°C (392°F) for 15–20 minutes until golden.
Slice and enjoy! 📹 Watch the recipe video on YouTube: https://youtube.com/shorts/RGQ-4n8i9Hg
